summary:
Jon Moritsugu is an American underground filmmaker and musician known for low-budget films that satirize popular genres and favor sound and spectacle over conventional storytelling. His work has screened at major film festivals and museums, and he received Creative Capital’s Moving Image award in 2001.

Born in 1965, Moritsugu began making films in high school and studied semiotics at Brown University. His 1987 student film, *Der Elvis*, drew critical praise. His features include *My Degeneration* (1989), *Hippy Porn* (1991), *Terminal USA* (1993), and cult favorite *Mod Fuck Explosion* (1994). Later films include *Fame Whore*, *Scumrock*, and *Pig Death Machine*. He often collaborates with his wife, filmmaker Amy Davis. In 2013, they received the Chicago Underground Film Festival’s Jack Smith Lifetime Achievement Award. Moritsugu also directed a Grammy-nominated music video for TV on the Radio and performs with Davis in Low on High. His memoir, *SKULLFUCK*, was published in 2022; *Numbskull Revolution* is listed for 2026.
